strict_group_purge_rule: For each LOAO experiment, identify every feature_hash group containing the held-out attack family and exclude those groups from train, validation, and calibration.
iid_test_role: Evaluation source for the held-out family; not used for fitting, preprocessing, calibration, or selection.
preprocessing: Refit preprocessing statistics using only each LOAO training subset. No held-out-family rows/groups may contribute.
binary_task_definition: Benign vs Attack. Held-out attack family is absent from fitting but evaluated as an unseen Attack at test time.
multiclass_task_definition: Train only on the remaining known classes. The held-out attack family is not a trained output class; evaluation therefore measures whether it is rejected/recognized as unreliable rather than conventional closed-set class recall.
temperature_scaling: Refit scalar temperature using only each LOAO calibration subset after strict held-out-group purge.
trust_policy: Confidence-based selective reliability evaluated for unseen-family samples; no held-out test labels used to fit temperature or thresholds.
